Done. The ledger module is implemented.

Files changed

- [autosolar/ledger.py](/absolute/path/autosolar/ledger.py) (new): implements the full T01 spec. `PRICES` with per model kind and unit suffixed price fields, `WEB_SEARCH_USD_PER_QUERY`, `UnknownModel`, `BudgetExceeded`, `call_cost_usd`, and `Ledger` with `record`, `rows`, `spent_usd`, and `check`. Only stdlib imports (`json`, `time`, `datetime`, `pathlib`), no network code.

What each piece does

- `call_cost_usd`: validates the model and counts (negative counts and `cached_tokens > input_tokens` raise `ValueError`), ignores `reasoning_tokens` for billing, rejects wrong unit counts per model kind, and prices token models as fresh input plus cached input plus output per 1M tokens plus search queries, per image models per image, and audio per second. `muse-glimmer-local` accepts token counts at cost 0 and rejects images, audio, and search.
- `Ledger.record`: rejects unknown usage keys before writing, prices via `call_cost_usd`, appends one JSON line, and returns the row with `ts_unix`, `run_id`, `stage`, `model`, `live`, `usage`, and `cost_usd`. It never refuses on caps.
- `Ledger.rows` / `spent_usd`: re read the file on every query so two objects share totals; a missing file is 0; any non JSON line raises `ValueError`; `spent_usd` filters by run and by live UTC day.
- `Ledger.check`: rejects negative estimates, enforces study and total caps always and live run plus live daily caps when `live` is true, allows exact equality within 1e-9 USD, and each `BudgetExceeded` message names the cap plus spent, estimate, and cap numbers.

Anything in the spec I could not do

- I could not run `uv run pytest tests/test_ledger.py`: the shell tool is unavailable in this environment (sandbox setup failure), so I verified the logic by hand against every acceptance test instead. The orchestrator run will be the real check.

Assumptions

- `PRICES` price field names are my choice (`input_usd_per_mtok`, `cached_input_usd_per_mtok`, `output_usd_per_mtok`, `usd_per_image`, `usd_per_s`), since the spec only requires `kind` plus price fields and the tests only assert `kind`.
- `reasoning_tokens` is accepted and ignored for every model kind, per the unqualified "accepted for logging only" rule; only billed token counts trigger wrong unit errors.
- Blank lines in the ledger file are tolerated; any other non JSON line raises `ValueError`.
- The live run cap compares the run total (all rows for that run), as the spec words it, not only live flagged rows.

Done. One file written; tests could not be executed here.

## Files changed

- [autosolar/meta_client.py](/absolute/path/to/autosolar/meta_client.py) (new): implements the full T02 spec. `DEFAULT_MODEL`, `STANDARD_SPARK_MODELS`, `MetaAPIError`, `Result` dataclass (`text`, `citations`, `web_searches`, `usage`, `cost_usd`, `response_id`, `model`, `rate_limit`, `raw`), and `MetaClient` with injectable `post`/`sleep`, key from `MODEL_API_KEY`, pre-call checks in spec order (standard-model refusal, `UnknownModel`, image-count rules, `ledger.check`), minimal body building, retry on 429/500/502/503/504 plus `ConnectionError`/`Timeout` with `sleep(0.5 * 2 ** attempt + random.uniform(0, 0.25))` up to `max_retries` retries, key-scrubbed and 500-char-truncated error messages, ledger recording (token counts plus `search_queries`, or `images` for per-image models), model-mismatch check after recording, and `Result` parsing (joined `output_text`, `url_citation` extraction, present rate-limit headers only).

## Not done / verification

- I could not run `uv run pytest`: the shell tool is unavailable in this session (sandbox setup failure), so no test output was observed. The orchestrator run will be the real check. I traced every acceptance test by hand against the code and each expectation lines up (body shapes, retry counts, wait bounds, cost formulas, ledger rows, scrubbing, truncation length).

## Assumptions

- Non-`per_image` models that are neither `tokens` kind (e.g. `per_audio_s`, `free`) follow the token path and its `images == 0` rule; the client has no audio parameter and the spec only defines token and per-image behavior.
- A 200 response with a missing/`None` `model` field is not a mismatch (nothing different was named); `Result.model` then falls back to the requested model.
- When `usage` exists but individual counters are missing or `None`, they count as 0; only a wholly missing/non-dict `usage` on a token model raises `MetaAPIError`.
- Rate-limit header matching is case-insensitive but reported under the spec's canonical lowercase names.
- No `--` sequences, no non-ASCII text, unit-suffixed names, and only stdlib plus `requests` (plus `PRICES`/`Ledger`/`UnknownModel` from the T01 ledger) are used, per `AGENTS.md`.
